states: Private mock stack: main (Tailwind v3) and this change (Tailwind v4) served side by side from one backend; Playwright loaded each route on both and compared every element's computed style plus a full-page screenshot pixel diff

64 route/theme/viewport states (16 routes x light and dark x 1440 and 390 with touch emulation at 390): 59 pixel-identical; the rest are mock drift (alert counts, last-refresh and last-scanned timestamps, tab-strip scroll timing) verified identical on rerun, plus 12 antialiased edge pixels on vSphere at 390
Docs page: identical pixels; prose text colors differ by at most 2/255 per channel because @tailwindcss/typography reads Tailwind 4's own palette
Machines at 390: row action button now renders its declared 44x44 touch target (28x28 under v3, whose lexical sort let the base min-h-6 win) while rows stay 32px; pixel-identical to main

Runtime scan of 82 states (every tab one level under each platform, Alerts, Patrol, Actions and Settings, with the first row expanded, at 1440 and 390) plus a static scan of shared-primitive call sites for class pairs whose cascade winner differs between v3 and v4: touch-target overrides keep their authored 44px phone size, cosmetic overrides that v3 never applied were removed so they keep rendering as today, and overrides v3 did apply use the v4 important suffix
Proxmox guest drawer and Docker host drawer at 1440 and the Proxmox storage table header at 800: pixel-identical
npm audit --json over the full graph: 0 findings; braces, micromatch, fast-glob and chokidar absent from the lockfile
